description: Release quarantine is 7 days -- the same window frontend/bunfig.toml enforces for bun (minimumReleaseAge = 604800). Change one and change the other; docs/dev/supply-chain.md explains why.

automerge is Renovate merging the PR itself once the branch is green -- not GitHub's auto-merge feature, which platformAutomerge would hand the decision to and which is switched off on this repository anyway. It is gated on the checks having actually run: a branch with no check runs at all reports as pending, not as passing, so nothing merges until someone presses Approve and run on the PR (Renovate runs on GITHUB_TOKEN and its PRs do not start workflows by themselves -- docs/dev/supply-chain.md). merge-commit matches how main is operated. Being at the top level, it is inherited by the blocks below: lockFileMaintenance's monthly full-lockfile refresh and vulnerabilityAlerts' zero-quarantine security updates automerge on the same condition as everything else, a green branch -- and a security PR whose lockfile could not be regenerated fails `bun install --frozen-lockfile` in CI, so it stays red rather than merging half-done.

vulnerabilityAlerts drops that wait for known CVEs. It only relaxes Renovate's own version choice: bun still refuses a version younger than 7 days when it refreshes bun.lock, so a frontend security PR for a fresh fix needs `cd frontend && bun install --minimum-release-age=0` by hand on the PR branch.

schedule: before 9am on the first day of the month

customManagers.description: The self-hosted Renovate image is pinned as tag@digest in .github/workflows/renovate.yml. The github-actions manager only reads `uses:` lines, so without this the bot would never update itself.

packageRules.description: Docker base images are referenced as tag + digest; keep the digest updated alongside the tag.

Anything inside .github/workflows/ stops at the Dependency Dashboard instead of becoming a pull request: the action SHAs, and the Renovate image pinned in renovate.yml itself. Renovate runs with the job's GITHUB_TOKEN (.github/workflows/renovate.yml), and GitHub refuses every write to a workflow file from that token -- an automatic PR here could only fail on push, every run, forever. Listing them keeps the staleness visible; apply them by hand, moving the SHA and its trailing version comment together. Ticking the checkbox will fail, so delete this rule if the workflow ever moves to a token carrying the `workflow` scope.
Go module updates travel as one PR per week unless they are major.
Same for the frontend's non-major dependencies; majors stay separate so they get read properly.

docs/requirements.txt and requirements-lint.txt are generated by `make lock-python` (pinned + hashed). Renovate cannot regenerate the hashes, so it must not edit them by hand -- bump the .in files locally instead. e2e is handled by the pep621 manager below, which does understand uv.lock.
